g.text: Process view - page of a guarded area, rendered on the server (US03): /manage as an example
GET /manage/clubs/{id}?… (with the cookies; refresh_token is not
x-pathname = path + query (over whatever the client sent)
200: the static shell starts streaming (the Suspense fallback
AreaGuard profile=Owner (inside Suspense, because it reads cookies)
200 account, or 401 (no session or expired token)
account or null; any other status throws → the area's error.tsx
The 200 status has already gone out: Next.js streams a meta tag
Goes to /login: GuestOnly and silent refresh (browser refresh
Streams AreaHeader and the page in place of the fallback
